name: Minimum
blurb: Core items only: the spine of the curriculum with nothing optional. Slower to the capstone, but every week still ends with something that runs.

name: Recommended
blurb: Core plus the recommended extensions the projects lean on. This is the pace the time estimates and the twelve-week plan assume.

name: Intensive
blurb: Everything, including the intensive extensions and stretch builds. Choose it for the weeks you are fresh, not as a permanent setting.
